name: Responsive
description: Connects Claude to Responsive so authenticated users can search approved company content, create and inspect assigned projects, generate first-draft responses, run Answer Agent, manage project comments, create intakes, and update answer workflows inside Responsive.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Responsive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Responsive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.rfpio.com/oa/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Responsive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Responsive lists 23 MCP tools, including add_project_comment, answer_agent, create_intake, create_project, generate_draft_response, get_collection_list, get_my_profile, get_my_project_list, get_my_unanswered_questions, get_my_unreviewed_project_questions, get_open_project_comments, and get_project_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Responsive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Responsive in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Responsive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Responsive is developed by RFPIO Inc. (d/b/a Responsive). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
